issues.problem: de-scope mistake: bad sentence 一人が映画を見に行きました is grammatical ('one person went to see a film'), so it is not a real error.
issues.action: Replaced bad sentence with 一人に映画を見に行きました (ungrammatical) and extended the note.

issues.problem: de-scope contrast with の claimed で is required for 一番, but 日本の一番高い山 is also grammatical.
issues.action: Reworded: で is the standard way to set the range for 一番; の merely labels the noun.

issues.problem: de-cause example 仕事で大阪へ行っています is circumstance/purpose ('on business'), not a cause bringing about an event as the rule states.
issues.action: Replaced with 大雨で試合が中止になりました (The match was called off because of the heavy rain).

issues.problem: de-means explain said 'on foot' uses the verb, not a particle, ignoring the correct 徒歩で.
issues.action: Rewrote: 歩いて行く (or 徒歩で), never 足で行く.

issues.problem: de-material explain overclaimed that the visible-material rule 'will never make you wrong'.
issues.action: Softened to 'it is the safe default'.

issues.problem: de-scope mistake note did not explain why the bad particle fails.
issues.action: Added 'に cannot mark how many people act.'
